evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ; modifies src/rpc/mempool.cpp, src/rpc/fees.cpp, and src/rpc/net.cpp to add sat/vB formatting options.
rationale: Adds optional sat/vB formatting across multiple RPC feerate outputs, addressing rounding risks and ecosystem impedance mismatches tracked in #32093. This provides clear value for external callers who currently must convert BTC/kvB manually, but is backwards-compatible and reasonably deferrable.
